question.text: Bleeding is stopped by the application of ferric chloride. This is because:

options.text: The blood starts flowing in opposite direction
The blood reacts and forms a solid, which seals the blood vessel
The blood is coagulated and thus the blood vessel is sealed
The ferric chloride seals the blood vessel

solution.text: Blood is a colloidal solution and <math> <mrow>  <msub>   <mrow>    <mtext>FeCl</mtext></mrow>   <mtext>3</mtext>  </msub>  </mrow></math> is a strong coagulant. Blood contains colloidal impurities and <math> <mrow>  <msub>   <mrow>    <mtext>FeCl</mtext></mrow>   <mtext>3</mtext>  </msub>  </mrow></math> neutralizes the charge on these colloidal impurities and clotting of blood begins which blocks the vessels and prevents any further flow of blood.
